column1: # screen field batch 9: GameScreen, slice 1 - the HUD/dialog wiring and the draw queues.
# Every assignment below was read out of createGlResources(), where the object built for each field
# names the field: the input multiplexer (g), the game-event listener (k), the unit commander the
# game mode provides (p, NetworkedUnitCommander when MultiplayerGameMode), the background loader (i),
# the sprite shader (aD) and the vector text renderer (aY).
# The selection triple: selectedUnits (u, what the panels and orders consume), selectionScratch (v,
# the buffer that expands a selection into its hosted sub-units and is cleared afterwards) and
# hoveredUnits (A, the units under the pointer that the click handlers turn into targets).
# The HUD widgets keep the type they are built from, disambiguated by their listener and by the
# panel they sit next to: lanNoticeDialog + lanNoticeListener, loadingProgressDialog (Lobby "Loading")
# minimapPanel with zoomButtonListener (and the zoom label bv), singleUnitPanel + unitPanelListener,
# The three DrawQueues are named by the layer switch that fills them: ch receives the Under layer and
# is drained by drawUnitSpriteUnder, ci receives everything else (sites, tile occupants, Base) and
# dispatches drawSite/drawUnitMoveTargetMarker/drawUnitSpriteAndOverlays, cj receives the Upper layer
# and is drained last. ck is the screen's FastRandom.
# Left unnamed on purpose: bx (a plain label created next to the minimap, whose text is never
# distinguishable from bv's) and the remaining camera/GL/state fields of the class.
